I have no solution, but a few suggestions:

  1. look in c:\programfiles to see if there is a mozilla entry that includes thunderbird. If so, you may have only lost the desktop icon,
  2. enter %appdata% in search box on task bar and press enter. that should open in appdata\roaming. look for a folder named thunderbird. if there, click it and open the profiles.ini file. That is a simple text file that has the name of the active profile. Then, open the appdata\roaming\thunderbird\profiles folder and see if that profile is there. If it is, you probably have all of your thunderbird documentation and a fresh download and install of thunderbird should get everything working again. To be safe, you may want to copy the full thunderbird folder prior to proceeding, If unsure of any steps, just ask.

content:
An easy way to switch is to click help>troubleshootinginformation, click 'profiles' and then click 'about:profiles.' That opens a page listing the profiles and you can launch a different one there.

On your question, yes there could be problems, primarily if you have a POP account on multiple profiles, as each time you switch profiles, thunderbird will download mail into the inbox on that profile, yet there will also be an onbox on another profile, causing your messages to be in two places. My suggestion for multiple profiles is to keep each profile unique (although IMAP accounts would not be a problem).

To clarify, you cannot load more than one profile at a time.

https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/how-install-and-use-another-language-dictionary-th

On top of https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/language-tools/ it explains what Dictionaries and Language Packs are used for.

Installing a dictionary add-on will add a new language option to your Thunderbird spell-checker, which checks your spelling when you fill out Web forms. Language pack add-ons change the language of the entire application.

Language packs are a way to have one install of Thunderbird but be able to change the language of the UI between two or more languages. They are not used with the spell checker.

Also many of the dictionaries on https://addons.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/language-tools/ are larger than the same language "Language Pack" to show the Language Pack cannot be a all in one thing.
